Continue?

Hisab Baki Pro stores all your data (customers, suppliers, transactions and business details) only on your phone. The app works offline and does not need an account.

We do not collect, upload or sell your data. No analytics or advertising tools are used.

The app opens your phone dialer, WhatsApp, SMS or sharing apps only when you tap a button, and only the content you choose (for example a reminder message or a PDF) is passed to them. You always confirm before anything is sent.

Backups and exports are saved to the location you choose. Please keep them safe because they contain your business records.

If you uninstall the app or clear its data without a backup, your records cannot be recovered. Create backups regularly in Settings > Backup and restore.
